why: Shard i running slot i+1 leaves slot 1 run by no machine and the last shard empty, and every shard job still exits green -- in CI, the costliest scope's entries silently skipped on every pull request. The completeness assertion over four independently computed shards is the case.
killedBy: --shard (issue #724) runs every selected entry exactly once across the shards, and never splits a scope
